QUESTION: Are the 6v6 teachers themselves payoff-specialized, independent of any compression? This localizes a Rung-1 failure to exactly one of two stages.
WHY_THIS_IS_THE_RIGHT_FIRST_DIAGNOSTIC: The 6v6 pipeline has two places a crossover can die: (1) the specialists never had complementary payoff specialization at 6v6, or (2) they had it and matched-state distillation into a shared-encoder controller lost it. These demand completely different responses, and no amount of tuning the distillation can legitimately rescue the claim under (1). Share-0 is a bit-exact z-dispatch between the two ALREADY-TRAINED, ALREADY-FROZEN teachers -- zero gradient steps of any kind, inference only -- so it separates (1) from (2) without spending a training cycle.
NO_TRAINING_OF_ANY_KIND: This evaluation performs no PPO, no distillation, and no fine-tuning. It loads two existing frozen checkpoints and dispatches between them. Nothing is retrained, reselected, or modified.

CHECKPOINTS_UNDER_TEST.note: These are the SAME checkpoints that served as distillation teachers for RUNG1_6V6. They are evaluated verbatim; the terminal-checkpoint rule is unchanged and no alternate epoch is eligible.
